observed_defects.observed: Full fresh init succeeded, but rerunning migration 003 failed with MySQL 1267: implicit utf8mb4_unicode_ci versus utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci in audit target ID equality.
observed_defects.fix: CAST order ID with explicit utf8mb4 character set and utf8mb4_unicode_ci collation; does not change schema, values, lifecycle policy or valid identifier equality.
observed_defects.retest: PASS full fresh + upgrade + rerun + recovery plus existing Linux regression on a new empty owned attempt-2 volume.

observed_defects.observed: Official MySQL image VOLUME /var/lib/mysql created an unused anonymous volume when test volume was mounted elsewhere. Isolation check stopped before init.
observed_defects.fix: Mount dedicated volume at /var/lib/mysql and use test subdirectory datadir; confirm one actual MySQL mount.
observed_defects.retest: PASS runtime isolation; unused anonymous resource proven owned and no longer referenced before removal.

migration_notes: init.sql contains DROP DATABASE for fixed schema; executed only after isolation and absent-business-DB checks. Never use it for upgrades.
Fresh init already records 001-005. Existence checks make reapplying scripts safe in tested schema; init.sql itself is not a reusable upgrade script.
MySQL DDL auto-commits; failed migration is not transactionally undone. Pause writes, use a single runner, do not use --force, correct prerequisite and rerun.
Schema equality in this check compares all columns/types/null/defaults, plus named critical index/FK checks; no assertion of exhaustive equivalence of every noncritical index/comment.
